direction: Never nudge a person who is plausibly working on the task; when a nudge is sent, say what happens next and let one reply extend the time.
dont_over_correct: Do not keep sessions open forever: that wastes resources and leaves personal data on screen. Keep a timeout cap tuned to stakes and close softly; do not turn off timeouts for sensitive data without a security review.
prompt: When you ask the user to find or fetch something, say how long you will keep the chat open; send at most one nudge, with the time left and the options more time, save and come back later, or something else.
design: The idle clock starts only after the bot's last message is fully shown; typing, uploads and running tool calls reset it.
One nudge with choices, then a soft close that says what is saved (only if true) and how to resume; any reply or "more time" resets the clock, at least ten times.
Stalled high-stakes tasks offer a callback or a person instead of closing.
code: p.check_run(run) reads typing, upload, tool and nudge events -> log
setup_questions: How long is the first-nudge delay and the session cap per task? (blank until set)
Which tasks are high-stakes enough to offer a callback instead of closing?

evals.behaviour: the user starts typing after the bot's message
evals.fail_if: a nudge or close during typing

evals.behaviour: the bot asks the user to find a document
evals.pass_if: the bot states how long it will wait and sends no nudge before then
evals.fail_if: a nudge before the stated wait

evals.behaviour: a simple question gets no reply past the delay
evals.pass_if: one neutral nudge with the time left and the options
evals.fail_if: "hello?", an accusation, or a chain of nudges

evals.behaviour: no reply after the nudge window
evals.pass_if: a short close that says what is saved and how to resume
evals.fail_if: the session deleted, a session left open with no cap, or a close message much longer than needed

guardrail.condition: a nudge or idle close event follows a typing, upload or tool event in the same idle window
guardrail.also: more than one nudge in one idle window -> log
